sections.title: Protected update downloads
notes: Sign in with shaedy-auth to authorize desktop update checks and downloads.
Update download access expires automatically and stops when its account session is revoked.

sections.title: Independent desktop previews
notes: The native desktop shell now has public source and independently verified Windows previews.
Official updates continue to require a signed package and release approval.

sections.title: Signed desktop releases
notes: Desktop updates are delivered securely from releases.shaedy.de.
Publishing preserves previous downloads and requires a separate release approval.

sections.title: Windows keyboard controls
notes: Desktop shortcuts remain available without a menu bar.
Holding a shortcut no longer repeatedly toggles fullscreen.
Account access and desktop controls stay accessible from the game.

sections.title: Desktop controls and secure updates
notes: The game window keeps its native title bar without an extra menu strip.
Use desktop controls for account access, fullscreen, zoom reset and signed updates.
Updates wait until you leave the game and explicitly confirm installation.
Desktop releases now use their own version and preserve local recovery and account sessions.

sections.title: Desktop account access
notes: Open account settings and sign out from the desktop menu.
Return directly to CaseSim after managing your account.

notes: Improved Windows preview installer packaging.

sections.title: Windows desktop preview
notes: Strengthened checks for offline startup and reconnecting without an app restart.

sections.title: Windows desktop preview
notes: Improved validation of account navigation and connection recovery in the Windows preview.

sections.title: Windows desktop preview
notes: Improved desktop startup and connection recovery.
The initial window fits the available display area.

sections.title: Windows desktop preview
notes: Try CaseSim in a native Windows app with your existing account.
